    38	/-- Etale-local surjectivity of a Yoneda map is surjectivity on the underlying points. -/
    39	theorem surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    40	    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology (yoneda.map f)) :
    41	    Function.Surjective f.base := by
    42	  intro y
    43	  let s : ToType ((yoneda.obj Y).obj (op (Spec (Y.residueField y)))) :=
    44	    Y.fromSpecResidueField y
    45	  have hmem := h.imageSieve_mem s
    46	  obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    47	    (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mp hmem
    48	  obtain ⟨r⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum (Y.residueField y)))
    49	  obtain ⟨i, z, hz⟩ := cover.exists_eq r
    50	  have hi : (Presieve.ofArrows cover.X cover.f) (cover.f i) := ⟨i⟩
    51	  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcover (cover.X i) (cover.f i) hi
    52	  change q ≫ f = cover.f i ≫ Y.fromSpecResidueField y at hq
    53	  refine ⟨q.base z, ?_⟩
    54	  have hqz := congrArg (fun g : cover.X i ⟶ Y => g.base z) hq
    55	  change f.base (q.base z) = (Y.fromSpecResidueField y).base ((cover.f i).base z) at hqz
    56	  rw [hz, Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply] at hqz
    57	  exact hqz

     9	# The finite-Galois invariance match for Picard zero
    10

    30	/-! ## The two slice presentations of a deck transformation -/
    31	
    32	/-- The deck transformation of a base-changed test, packaged as a morphism in
    33	the slice over `Spec L`. -/
    34	noncomputable def pic0GalTwistMor
    35	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    36	    (pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T) ⟶
    37	      baseTest (k' := L) T :=
    38	  Over.homMk (pullbackGalMap K L T.hom gamma)
    39	    (pullbackGalMap_snd K L T.hom gamma)
    40	
    41	@[simp]
    42	theorem pic0GalTwistMor_left
    43	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    44	    (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).left = pullbackGalMap K L T.hom gamma :=
    45	  rfl
    46	
    47	/-- Base change of a morphism of `K`-tests, regarded as a morphism of their
    48	base changes over `Spec L`. -/
    49	noncomputable def pic0GaloisBaseChangeMor
    50	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T) :
    51	    baseTest (k' := L) T' ⟶ baseTest (k' := L) T :=
    52	  Over.homMk (pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w)
    53	    (pullbackBaseChange_snd K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w)
    54	
    55	theorem pic0GaloisBaseTestMap_eq_restrict_map
    56	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T) :
    57	    pic0GaloisBaseTestMap (L := L) a =
    58	      (pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
    59	        (pic0GaloisBaseChangeMor (L := L) a) :=
    60	  rfl
    61	
    62	/-- The inverse comparison from a twisted `L`-test to the original test is the
    63	identity on underlying schemes. -/
    64	theorem pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso_inv_app_left
    65	    (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (D : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))) :
    66	    ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app D).left = 𝟙 D.left := by
    67	  have h := congrArg Over.Hom.left
    68	    ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom_inv_id_app D)
    69	  rw [Over.comp_left, pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso_hom_app_left] at h
    70	  have hfixed : @Eq (D.left ⟶ D.left)
    71	      (𝟙 D.left ≫ ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app D).left)
    72	      (𝟙 D.left) := h
    73	  rw [Category.id_comp] at hfixed
    74	  exact hfixed
    75	
    76	/-- The `K`-slice deck transformation indexed by `gamma⁻¹` is the restriction
    77	of the `L`-slice deck transformation indexed by `gamma`, after the canonical
    78	identity-underlying comparison of their sources. -/
    79	theorem twistTest_eq_pic0GaloisRestrict_galTwistMor
    80	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    81	    twistTest T gamma⁻¹ =
    82	      (pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app (baseTest (k' := L) T) ≫
    83	        (pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
    84	          (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma) := by
    85	  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    86	  rw [Over.comp_left, pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso_inv_app_left,
    87	    Over.map_map_left, pic0GalTwistMor_left]
    88	  have hfixed : @Eq
    89	      (Limits.pullback T.hom (specMapAlgebra K L) ⟶
    90	        Limits.pullback T.hom (specMapAlgebra K L))
    91	      (𝟙 _ ≫ pullbackGalMap K L T.hom gamma)
    92	      (pullbackGalMap K L T.hom gamma) :=
    93	    Category.id_comp _
    94	  exact hfixed.symm

    98	section ThetaAction
    99	
   100	variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
   101	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   102	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   103	
   104	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
   105	-- Normalizing both theta components and the restriction-twist inverse is expensive.
   106	/-- The theta comparison carries invariance under the inverse-indexed deck
   107	transformation to the canonical Galois-action equation. -/
   108	theorem pic0_theta_invariant_iff_action
   109	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
   110	    (y : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).obj
   111	      (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   112	    (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
   113	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (twistTest T gamma⁻¹).op
   114	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   115	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) =
   116	        (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   117	          (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y ↔
   118	      (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).map
   119	          (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).op y =
   120	        (pic0GaloisAction C gamma).inv.app
   121	          (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y := by
   122	  constructor
   123	  · intro h
   124	    rw [twistTest_eq_pic0GaloisRestrict_galTwistMor,
   125	      op_comp, Functor.map_comp] at h
   126	    have he : (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   127	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
   128	            (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma)).op
   129	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   130	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) =
   131	        (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   132	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom.app
   133	            (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op
   134	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   135	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) := by
   136	      calc
   137	        _ = (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   138	            ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom.app
   139	              (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op
   140	            ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   141	              ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app
   142	                (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op
   143	              ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   144	                ((pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
   145	                  (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma)).op
   146	                ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   147	                  (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y))) := by
   148	            symm
   149	            rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp,
   150	              Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
   151	            simpa using Functor.map_id_apply (pic0TypeFunctor C)
   152	              (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma ⋙
   153	                pic0GaloisRestrictTest).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T))) _
   154	        _ = _ := congrArg ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   155	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom.app
   156	            (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op) h
   157	    apply (Iso.toEquiv ((pic0ThetaType K L C).app
   158	      (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj
   159	        (baseTest (k' := L) T))))).injective
   160	    change (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   161	        (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   162	          ((pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).map
   163	            (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).op y) =
   164	      (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   165	        (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   166	          ((pic0GaloisAction C gamma).inv.app
   167	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y)
   168	    rw [pic0GaloisAction_inv_app_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
   169	    rw [pic0GaloisActionRestricted_inv_app]
   170	    rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply]
   171	    exact he
   172	  · intro h
   173	    have htheta := congrArg ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   174	      (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj
   175	        (baseTest (k' := L) T)))) h
   176	    have he : (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   177	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
   178	            (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma)).op
   179	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   180	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) =
   181	        (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   182	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom.app
   183	            (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op
   184	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   185	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) := by
   186	      calc
   187	        _ = (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   188	            (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj
   189	              (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   190	            ((pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).map
   191	              (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).op y) :=
   192	          (NatTrans.naturality_apply (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom
   193	            (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma).op y).symm
   194	        _ = (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   195	            (op ((pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).obj
   196	              (baseTest (k' := L) T)))
   197	            ((pic0GaloisAction C gamma).inv.app
   198	              (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y) := htheta
   199	        _ = _ := by
   200	          rw [pic0GaloisAction_inv_app_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
   201	          rw [pic0GaloisActionRestricted_inv_app]
   202	          rfl
   203	    rw [twistTest_eq_pic0GaloisRestrict_galTwistMor,
   204	      op_comp, Functor.map_comp]
   205	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   206	        ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).inv.app
   207	          (baseTest (k' := L) T)).op
   208	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   209	          ((pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := K) (L := L)).map
   210	            (pic0GalTwistMor T gamma)).op
   211	          ((pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   212	            (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y)) =
   213	      (pic0ThetaType K L C).hom.app
   214	        (op (baseTest (k' := L) T)) y
   215	    rw [he]
   216	    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp,
   217	      Iso.inv_hom_id_app, op_id, Functor.map_id_apply]

   221	/-! ## Equivariance as a slice square -/
   222	
   223	section Representative
   224	
   225	variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
   226	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   227	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   228	variable {J : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))}
   229	  (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).RepresentableBy J)
   230	
   231	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
   232	-- Expanding the transported Galois action needs more than the default heartbeat budget.
   233	/-- Equivariance for the canonical action is exactly the corresponding square
   234	in the slice over `Spec L`. -/
   235	theorem pic0_isEquivariant_iff_galTwistMor
   236	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
   237	    (phi : baseTest (k' := L) T ⟶ J) :
   238	    (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L T.hom).IsEquivariant
   239	        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep) phi.left ↔
   240	      ∀ gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
   241	        pic0GalTwistMor T gamma ≫ phi =
   242	          (pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma).map phi ≫
   243	            pic0GaloisTwistMor C rep gamma := by
   244	  constructor
   245	  · intro h gamma
   246	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext (h gamma)
   247	  · intro h gamma
   248	    exact congrArg Over.Hom.left (h gamma)
   249

     8	/-!
     9	# Canonical cocycles of representability isomorphisms
    10	
    11	`Functor.RepresentableBy.uniqueUpToIso` is defined by Yoneda uniqueness, but mathlib does
    12	not expose the two equations that descent data consume: its universal-element intertwining
    13	formula and transitivity for three independently chosen representing objects.  These generic
    14	lemmas make those equations explicit.  In particular, the transitivity theorem proves a
    15	three-face cocycle without defining the `1,3` face as a composite.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe v u u'
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory
    23	
    24	namespace CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy
    25	
    26	/-- Transport a representation through the right adjoint of an adjunction.
    27	
    28	This is the categorical pullback step used for overlap bases: if `L ⊣ R`, then a
    29	representation of `F` by `Y` induces one of `L.op ⋙ F` by `R.obj Y`.  The statement
    30	requires only the adjunction; for schemes, `Over.mapPullbackAdj` supplies it whenever
    31	the relevant pullbacks exist, including tensor-product (non-field) bases. -/
    32	noncomputable def ofLeftAdjoint
    33	    {C : Type u} {D : Type u'} [Category.{v, u} C] [Category.{v, u'} D]
    34	    {L : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} (adj : L ⊣ R)
    35	    {F : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v} {Y : D} (e : F.RepresentableBy Y) :
    36	    (L.op ⋙ F).RepresentableBy (R.obj Y) :=
    37	  (adj.representableBy Y).ofIso (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft L.op e.toIso)
    38	
    39	/-- The universal element of `ofLeftAdjoint` is obtained by applying the adjunction inverse. -/
    40	theorem ofLeftAdjoint_homEquiv
    41	    {C : Type u} {D : Type u'} [Category.{v, u} C] [Category.{v, u'} D]
    42	    {L : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} (adj : L ⊣ R)
    43	    {F : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v} {Y : D} (e : F.RepresentableBy Y)
    44	    {X : C} (g : X ⟶ R.obj Y) :
    45	    (ofLeftAdjoint adj e).homEquiv g = e.homEquiv ((adj.homEquiv X Y).symm g) := by
    46	  rfl
    47	
    48	/-- Compare representations of two isomorphic presheaves.
    49	
    50	The source representation is first transported along `η`; the comparison is then the ordinary
    51	Yoneda comparison.  This is the canonical overlap isomorphism once the two pullback Picard
    52	presheaves have been identified. -/
    53	noncomputable def uniqueUpToIsoOfIso
    54	    {C : Type u} [Category.{v, u} C]
    55	    {F F' : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v} {Y Y' : C}
    56	    (e : F.RepresentableBy Y) (e' : F'.RepresentableBy Y') (η : F ≅ F') : Y ≅ Y' :=
    57	  (e.ofIso η).uniqueUpToIso e'
    58	
    59	/-- The comparison in `uniqueUpToIsoOfIso` intertwines the two universal elements. -/
    60	theorem homEquiv_uniqueUpToIsoOfIso_hom
    61	    {C : Type u} [Category.{v, u} C]
    62	    {F F' : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v} {Y Y' : C}
    63	    (e : F.RepresentableBy Y) (e' : F'.RepresentableBy Y') (η : F ≅ F')
    64	    {X : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    65	    e'.homEquiv (f ≫ (uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e e' η).hom) =
    66	      η.hom.app (Opposite.op X) (e.homEquiv f) := by
    67	  change e'.homEquiv (f ≫ ((e.ofIso η).uniqueUpToIso e').hom) =
    68	    (e.ofIso η).homEquiv f
    69	  have h : ((e.ofIso η).uniqueUpToIso e').hom =
    70	      e'.homEquiv.symm ((e.ofIso η).homEquiv (𝟙 Y)) := rfl
    71	  rw [h, comp_homEquiv_symm, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    72	  rw [← (e.ofIso η).homEquiv_comp f (𝟙 Y), Category.comp_id]
    73	
    74	/-- Transporting a representation across conjugate adjunctions produces the conjugate
    75	right-adjoint isomorphism on the representing object. -/
    76	theorem uniqueUpToIsoOfIso_ofLeftAdjoint_conjugate
    77	    {C : Type u} {D : Type u'} [Category.{v, u} C] [Category.{v, u'} D]
    78	    {L₁ L₂ : C ⥤ D} {R₁ R₂ : D ⥤ C}
    79	    (adj₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (adj₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (α : L₂ ≅ L₁)
    80	    {F : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v} {Y : D} (e : F.RepresentableBy Y) :
    81	    uniqueUpToIsoOfIso
    82	      (ofLeftAdjoint adj₁ e)
    83	      (ofLeftAdjoint adj₂ e)
    84	      (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.op α) F) =
    85	      (conjugateIsoEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).app Y := by
    86	  let e₁ := ofLeftAdjoint adj₁ e
    87	  let e₂ := ofLeftAdjoint adj₂ e
    88	  apply Iso.ext
    89	  apply e₂.homEquiv.injective
    90	  have h : (adj₂.homEquiv (R₁.obj Y) Y).symm
    91	      ((conjugateIsoEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).app Y).hom =
    92	      α.hom.app (R₁.obj Y) ≫ adj₁.counit.app Y := by
    93	    apply (adj₂.homEquiv (R₁.obj Y) Y).injective
    94	    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    95	    have hc := conjugateEquiv_counit adj₁ adj₂ α.hom Y
    96	    have hn := adj₂.homEquiv_naturality_left
    97	      (X' := R₁.obj Y) (X := R₂.obj Y) (Y := Y)
    98	      ((conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α.hom).app Y) (adj₂.counit.app Y)
    99	    have hunit : (adj₂.homEquiv (R₂.obj Y) Y) (adj₂.counit.app Y) =
   100	        𝟙 (R₂.obj Y) := by
   101	      have hh := adj₂.homEquiv_counit (R₂.obj Y) Y (𝟙 (R₂.obj Y))
   102	      have hh' := congrArg (adj₂.homEquiv (R₂.obj Y) Y) hh
   103	      simpa using hh'.symm
   104	    change (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α.hom).app Y = _
   105	    calc
   106	      (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α.hom).app Y =
   107	          (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α.hom).app Y ≫ 𝟙 _ := by simp
   108	      _ = (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α.hom).app Y ≫
   109	          (adj₂.homEquiv (R₂.obj Y) Y) (adj₂.counit.app Y) := by
   110	        rw [hunit, Category.comp_id]
   111	      _ = (adj₂.homEquiv (R₁.obj Y) Y)
   112	          (L₂.map ((conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α.hom).app Y) ≫ adj₂.counit.app Y) :=
   113	        hn.symm
   114	      _ = (adj₂.homEquiv (R₁.obj Y) Y)
   115	          (α.hom.app (R₁.obj Y) ≫ adj₁.counit.app Y) := by
   116	        exact congrArg (adj₂.homEquiv (R₁.obj Y) Y) hc
   117	  calc
   118	    e₂.homEquiv
   119	        (uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e₁ e₂
   120	          (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.op α) F)).hom =
   121	      (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.op α) F).hom.app
   122	          (Opposite.op (R₁.obj Y)) (e₁.homEquiv (𝟙 _)) := by
   123	      simpa using homEquiv_uniqueUpToIsoOfIso_hom
   124	        e₁ e₂ (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.op α) F) (𝟙 _)
   125	    _ = e.homEquiv (α.hom.app (R₁.obj Y) ≫ adj₁.counit.app Y) := by
   126	      simp only [Functor.isoWhiskerRight_hom, Functor.whiskerRight_app]
   127	      dsimp [e₁]
   128	      rw [ofLeftAdjoint_homEquiv]
   129	      have hunit : (adj₁.homEquiv (R₁.obj Y) Y).symm (𝟙 (R₁.obj Y)) =
   130	          adj₁.counit.app Y := by
   131	        have hh := adj₁.homEquiv_counit (R₁.obj Y) Y (𝟙 (R₁.obj Y))
   132	        simpa using hh
   133	      rw [hunit]
   134	      change (ConcreteCategory.hom (F.map (α.hom.app (R₁.obj Y)).op))
   135	          (e.homEquiv (adj₁.counit.app Y)) =
   136	        e.homEquiv (α.hom.app (R₁.obj Y) ≫ adj₁.counit.app Y)
   137	      exact (e.homEquiv_comp
   138	        (α.hom.app (R₁.obj Y)) (adj₁.counit.app Y)).symm
   139	    _ = e₂.homEquiv ((conjugateIsoEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).app Y).hom := by
   140	      rw [ofLeftAdjoint_homEquiv, h]
   141	      rfl

   143	/-- Applying one adjunction to two representations carries their canonical comparison
   144	to the image of the original comparison under the right adjoint. -/
   145	theorem uniqueUpToIsoOfIso_ofLeftAdjoint_mapIso
   146	    {C : Type u} {D : Type u'} [Category.{v, u} C] [Category.{v, u'} D]
   147	    {L : C ⥤ D} {R : D ⥤ C} (adj : L ⊣ R)
   148	    {F F' : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v} {Y Y' : D}
   149	    (e : F.RepresentableBy Y) (e' : F'.RepresentableBy Y') (η : F ≅ F') :
   150	    uniqueUpToIsoOfIso
   151	      (ofLeftAdjoint adj e)
   152	      (ofLeftAdjoint adj e')
   153	      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft L.op η) =
   154	      R.mapIso (uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e e' η) := by
   155	  apply Iso.ext
   156	  apply (ofLeftAdjoint adj e').homEquiv.injective
   157	  calc
   158	    (ofLeftAdjoint adj e').homEquiv
   159	        ((uniqueUpToIsoOfIso
   160	          (ofLeftAdjoint adj e)
   161	          (ofLeftAdjoint adj e')
   162	          (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft L.op η)).hom) =
   163	      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft L.op η).hom.app
   164	        (Opposite.op (R.obj Y))
   165	        ((ofLeftAdjoint adj e).homEquiv (𝟙 _)) := by
   166	      simpa using homEquiv_uniqueUpToIsoOfIso_hom
   167	        (ofLeftAdjoint adj e)
   168	        (ofLeftAdjoint adj e')
   169	        (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft L.op η) (𝟙 _)
   170	    _ = (ofLeftAdjoint adj e').homEquiv
   171	        (R.mapIso (uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e e' η)).hom := by
   172	      change (ConcreteCategory.hom
   173	          (η.hom.app (L.op.obj (Opposite.op (R.obj Y)))))
   174	          (e.homEquiv ((adj.homEquiv (R.obj Y) Y).symm (𝟙 _))) =
   175	        e'.homEquiv ((adj.homEquiv (R.obj Y) Y').symm
   176	          (R.map (uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e e' η).hom))
   177	      rw [show (adj.homEquiv (R.obj Y) Y').symm
   178	          (R.map (uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e e' η).hom) =
   179	        (adj.homEquiv (R.obj Y) Y).symm (𝟙 _) ≫
   180	          (uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e e' η).hom by
   181	        simpa using adj.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm
   182	          (𝟙 (R.obj Y)) (uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e e' η).hom]
   183	      symm
   184	      exact homEquiv_uniqueUpToIsoOfIso_hom e e' η
   185	        ((adj.homEquiv (R.obj Y) Y).symm (𝟙 _))

   187	/-- The canonical comparison for the inverse presheaf isomorphism is the inverse
   188	of the original comparison. -/
   189	theorem uniqueUpToIsoOfIso_symm
   190	    {C : Type u} [Category.{v, u} C]
   191	    {F F' : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v} {Y Y' : C}
   192	    (e : F.RepresentableBy Y) (e' : F'.RepresentableBy Y') (η : F ≅ F') :
   193	    (uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e e' η).symm =
   194	      uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e' e η.symm := by
   195	  let u := uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e e' η
   196	  let v := uniqueUpToIsoOfIso e' e η.symm
   197	  apply Iso.ext
   198	  change u.inv = v.hom
   199	  apply (cancel_mono u.hom).1
   200	  have hvu : v.hom ≫ u.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
   201	    apply e'.homEquiv.injective
   202	    calc
   203	      e'.homEquiv (v.hom ≫ u.hom) =
   204	          η.hom.app (Opposite.op Y')
   205	            (e.homEquiv v.hom) := by
   206	        simpa [u, v] using
   207	          homEquiv_uniqueUpToIsoOfIso_hom e e' η v.hom
   208	      _ = η.hom.app (Opposite.op Y')
   209	          (η.inv.app (Opposite.op Y') (e'.homEquiv (𝟙 _))) := by
   210	        rw [show e.homEquiv v.hom =
   211	            η.inv.app (Opposite.op Y') (e'.homEquiv (𝟙 _)) by
   212	          simpa [v] using
   213	            homEquiv_uniqueUpToIsoOfIso_hom e' e η.symm (𝟙 Y')]
   214	      _ = e'.homEquiv (𝟙 _) := by

    52	/-- **The δ `CommRingCat` diagram.**  The finite subextensions `k''` of `K`, as commutative
    53	rings, with the field inclusions `k'' ↪ k'''` as transition maps.  Its filtered colimit is
    54	`K` (`deltaIsColimit`): the honest ring-level "`K = colim k''`". -/
    55	noncomputable def deltaRingDiagram : FinSubext k K ⥤ CommRingCat.{u} where
    56	  obj L := CommRingCat.of L.1
    57	  map {L₁ L₂} h := CommRingCat.ofHom (IntermediateField.inclusion (leOfHom h)).toRingHom
    58	  map_id L := by
    59	    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    60	    ext x
    61	    simp [IntermediateField.inclusion_self]
    62	  map_comp {L₁ L₂ L₃} f g := by
    63	    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    64	    ext x
    65	    simp [IntermediateField.inclusion_inclusion]
    66	
    67	/-- **The δ colimit cocone.**  The inclusion cocone from the finite subextensions to the
    68	whole field `K`, with `app k'' = k'' ↪ K`. -/
    69	noncomputable def deltaCocone : Cocone (deltaRingDiagram (k := k) (K := K)) where
    70	  pt := CommRingCat.of K
    71	  ι :=
    72	    { app := fun L => CommRingCat.ofHom (IntermediateField.val L.1).toRingHom
    73	      naturality := fun {L₁ L₂} h => by
    74	        apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    75	        ext x
    76	        rfl }
    77	
    78	/-- **The δ colimit `K = colim k''` (ring level).**  The inclusion cocone `deltaCocone` is a
    79	colimit: `forget CommRingCat` reflects filtered colimits, and on underlying types the cocone
    80	is a filtered colimit by `Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf'` — joint surjectivity is the
    81	landed `coe_iSup_finSubext`/`iSup_finSubext_eq_top` (every `x : K` lives at a finite stage),
    82	and the injections are the field inclusions. -/
    83	noncomputable def deltaIsColimit [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] :
    84	    IsColimit (deltaCocone (k := k) (K := K)) := by
    85	  haveI : ReflectsColimit (deltaRingDiagram (k := k) (K := K)) (forget CommRingCat.{u}) :=
    86	    reflectsColimit_of_reflectsIsomorphisms _ _
    87	  apply isColimitOfReflects (forget CommRingCat.{u})
    88	  refine Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' _ _ ?_ ?_
    89	  · intro x
    90	    have hx : x ∈ ⋃ L : FinSubext k K, (L.1 : Set K) := by
    91	      rw [← coe_iSup_finSubext, iSup_finSubext_eq_top]; trivial
    92	    obtain ⟨L, hxL⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    93	    exact ⟨L, ⟨x, hxL⟩, rfl⟩
    94	  · intro L x y hxy
    95	    exact ⟨L, 𝟙 L, by rw [show x = y from Subtype.ext hxy]⟩
    96	
    97	end FieldColimit

    99	/-! ## The δ scheme system `S : (FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Over (Spec k)` -/
   100	
   101	section SchemeSystem
   102	
   103	variable {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   104	
   105	/-- The underlying scheme of `overSpec k A` is affine (it is `Spec A`). -/
   106	instance isAffine_overSpec_left (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
   107	    IsAffine (overSpec k A).left :=
   108	  inferInstanceAs (IsAffine (Spec _))
   109	
   110	/-- The δ scheme transition morphism `Spec k''' ⟶ Spec k''` in `Over (Spec k)`, for
   111	`k'' ≤ k'''`: `Spec` of the field inclusion `k'' ↪ k'''`.  Well-defined over `Spec k`
   112	because the inclusion is a `k`-algebra map. -/
   113	noncomputable def deltaSchemeMap {L₁ L₂ : FinSubext k K} (h : L₁.1 ≤ L₂.1) :
   114	    overSpec k L₂.1 ⟶ overSpec k L₁.1 :=
   115	  Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom)) (by
   116	    simp only [overSpec_left, Over.mk_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   117	    congr 2)
   118	
   119	@[simp]
   120	lemma deltaSchemeMap_left {L₁ L₂ : FinSubext k K} (h : L₁.1 ≤ L₂.1) :
   121	    (deltaSchemeMap h).left
   122	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom) :=
   123	  rfl
   124	
   125	/-- **The δ scheme diagram.**  `S.obj (op k'') = overSpec k k'' = Spec k''` over `Spec k`,
   126	with the transition maps `Spec` of the field inclusions.  Its limit is `Spec K = overSpec k K`
   127	(`deltaSchemeIsLimit`). -/
   128	noncomputable def deltaSchemeDiagram : (FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)) where
   129	  obj L := overSpec k (unop L).1
   130	  map {L₁ L₂} h := deltaSchemeMap (leOfHom h.unop)
   131	  map_id L := by
   132	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   133	    simp only [deltaSchemeMap_left, Over.id_left, overSpec_left]
   134	    rw [← Spec.map_id]
   135	    congr 1
   136	  map_comp {L₁ L₂ L₃} f g := by
   137	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   138	    simp only [Over.comp_left, deltaSchemeMap_left, overSpec_left, ← Spec.map_comp,
   139	      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   140	    congr 2
   141	
   142	@[simp]
   143	lemma deltaSchemeDiagram_map {L₁ L₂ : (FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ} (h : L₁ ⟶ L₂) :
   144	    deltaSchemeDiagram.map h = deltaSchemeMap (leOfHom h.unop) :=
   145	  rfl
   146	
   147	/-- Every δ transition map is affine (`Spec` of a field hom; both source and target are
   148	affine). -/
   149	instance deltaSchemeMap_isAffineHom {L₁ L₂ : FinSubext k K} (h : L₁.1 ≤ L₂.1) :
   150	    IsAffineHom (deltaSchemeMap h).left :=
   151	  isAffineHom_of_isAffine _
   152	
   153	/-- Every δ stage is a one-point (hence compact) space: `Spec` of a field. -/
   154	instance deltaSchemeDiagram_compactSpace (L : (FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ) :
   155	    CompactSpace ((deltaSchemeDiagram.obj L).left) :=
   156	  inferInstanceAs (CompactSpace (Spec _))
   157	
   158	/-- Every δ stage is quasi-separated: `Spec` of a field is affine. -/
   159	instance deltaSchemeDiagram_quasiSeparatedSpace (L : (FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ) :
   160	    QuasiSeparatedSpace ((deltaSchemeDiagram.obj L).left) :=
   161	  inferInstanceAs (QuasiSeparatedSpace (Spec _))
   162	
   163	end SchemeSystem

   165	/-! ## The δ scheme limit `Spec K = lim S` -/

   167	section SchemeLimit
   168	
   169	variable {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K]
   170	
   171	/-- `Scheme.Spec` is a right adjoint (`Γ ⊣ Spec`), so it preserves the δ cofiltered limit. -/
   172	noncomputable instance : PreservesLimitsOfShape (FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ Scheme.Spec.{u} :=
   173	  inferInstance
   174	
   175	omit [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] in
   176	/-- **The δ bridge (definitional).**  Forgetting the base of the δ *scheme* diagram gives the
   177	δ *ring* diagram, opposite, under `Scheme.Spec`: both send `k'' ↦ Spec k''`. -/
   178	lemma deltaScheme_forget_eq :
   179	    deltaSchemeDiagram (k := k) (K := K) ⋙ Over.forget (Spec (.of k))
   180	      = deltaRingDiagram.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec := rfl
   181	
   182	/-- The forgotten δ scheme diagram (`k'' ↦ Spec k''` in `Scheme`) has a limit `Spec K`: it is
   183	`Scheme.Spec` of the δ ring colimit `deltaIsColimit` (opposite), and `Scheme.Spec` (right adjoint
   184	`Γ ⊣ Spec`) preserves limits.  This is the honest `Spec K_s = lim_{k''} Spec k''`. -/
   185	noncomputable instance hasLimit_deltaScheme_forget :
   186	    HasLimit (deltaSchemeDiagram (k := k) (K := K) ⋙ Over.forget (Spec (.of k))) := by
   187	  rw [deltaScheme_forget_eq]
   188	  exact ⟨_, isLimitOfPreserves Scheme.Spec deltaIsColimit.op⟩
   189	
   190	/-- **The δ scheme colimit `Spec K = lim S`.**  The δ scheme diagram `S` has a limit — `Spec K`:
   191	`Over.forget (Spec k)` *creates* limits of this (cofiltered ⟹ connected) shape, lifting the
   192	forgotten limit `Spec K = Scheme.Spec (colim_{k''} k'')` (`hasLimit_deltaScheme_forget`) uniquely
   193	to `Over (Spec k)`.  So the δ scheme system `S` is a legal input to the β1 residual
   194	`Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit`, and its limit is `Spec K_s`. -/
   195	noncomputable instance : HasLimit (deltaSchemeDiagram (k := k) (K := K)) := by
   196	  haveI : IsConnected (FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ := IsCofiltered.isConnected _
   197	  exact hasLimit_of_created (deltaSchemeDiagram (k := k) (K := K)) (Over.forget (Spec (.of k)))
   198	
   199	end SchemeLimit

   201	/-! ## The δ system plugs into the β1 residual, and the mountain
   202	
   203	`preservesColimit_deltaScheme_of_residual` closes the loop of deliverable 1: the concrete δ
   204	scheme system `deltaSchemeDiagram` (all its residual hypotheses — affine transition maps,
   205	compact and quasi-separated stages, `HasLimit`/`Spec K = lim S` — discharged above) **is a legal
   206	input** to the β1 residual `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C`, and feeding it in yields the
   207	concrete β1-at-`K_s` statement:
   208	
   209	> `pic0TypeFunctor C` sends `Spec K_s = lim_{k''} Spec k''` to the filtered colimit of its values,
   210	> i.e. `colim_{k''} pic0Subgroup C (Spec k'') → pic0Subgroup C (Spec K_s)` is a bijection.
   211	
   212	**The mountain (`Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C`) is NOT discharged here** — it is the
   213	genuine M–L residual (landing notes I-0263/I-0266), stating that `pic0TypeFunctor C` is *locally
   214	of finite presentation as a functor*.  On affine tests `overSpec k A` it is exactly that
   215	`PicEtAff C A` (hence `pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k A)`) commutes with filtered colimits of the test
   216	algebra `A`, riding **finite presentation of the proper smooth curve `C/k`**: `C.hom` is
   217	`SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1` (hence `LocallyOfFiniteType`/`LocallyOfFinitePresentation`) and
   218	`IsProper` (hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated), so `C.hom` is finitely presented.  The
   219	general (qcqs) case reduces to the affine one by spreading the affine opens and sections of
   220	`S_{K_s} = lim S_{k''}` back to a finite stage.  Named mathlib avatars (`v4.31.0`):
   221	`CommRingCat.preservesColimit_coyoneda_of_finitePresentation`
   222	(`Algebra/Category/Ring/FinitePresentation.lean:144`),
   223	`RingHom.EssFiniteType.exists_eq_comp_ι_app_of_isColimit` (`:81`) /

   225	`Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation`
   226	(`AlgebraicGeometry/AffineTransitionLimit.lean:1177`),
   227	`Scheme.exists_hom_hom_comp_eq_comp_of_locallyOfFiniteType` (`:686`),
   228	`Scheme.exists_isAffineOpen_preimage_eq` (`:1058`) / `exists_isOpenCover_and_isAffine` (`:1078`).

   231	section Residual
   232	
   233	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   234	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   235	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K]
   236	
   237	/-- **The δ system plugs into the β1 residual.**  Given the β1 residual
   238	`Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C` (the pinned M–L mountain), the concrete δ scheme system
   239	`deltaSchemeDiagram`, with all its residual hypotheses discharged (affine transition maps,
   240	compact and quasi-separated `Spec`-of-field stages, and `HasLimit`/`Spec K = lim S`), yields
   241	β1-at-`K_s`: `pic0TypeFunctor C` preserves the δ colimit
   242	`colim_{k''} pic0(Spec k'') → pic0(Spec K)`.  This is the honest consumption of the δ substrate
   243	by the residual, `divRep`-free. -/
   244	theorem preservesColimit_deltaScheme_of_residual
   245	    (h : Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C) :
   246	    PreservesColimit (deltaSchemeDiagram (k := k) (K := K)).op (pic0TypeFunctor C) := by
   247	  apply h (deltaSchemeDiagram (k := k) (K := K))
   248	  · intro i j f
   249	    exact deltaSchemeMap_isAffineHom (leOfHom f.unop)
   250	  · intro i
   251	    exact deltaSchemeDiagram_compactSpace i

     9	/-!
    10	# DAT-G0 β1 — the base-field directed system `K_s = colim k''` (DG-G0.δ) and the pinned residual
    11	
    12	This file lands **DG-G0.δ** (mini-spec `informal/spec-datg0.md` §3, landing notes I-0259/I-0263):
    13	the base-field directed system whose colimit is the separable closure `K_s`, over which the
    14	β1 residual `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit` (landed in `Picard/PicRepColimitCompat.lean`,
    15	commit c9df8d479) is quantified.
    16	
    17	## DG-G0.δ — the substrate the residual quantifies over
    18	
    19	For a **separable algebraic** extension `K/k` (the case `K = K_s` a separable closure is the
    20	DAT-G0 target), the finite subextensions form a **directed system** whose supremum is all of
    21	`K`.  Concretely:
    22	
    23	* `FinSubext k K` — the index: finite(-dimensional) `k`-subextensions `k''` of `K`, ordered by
    24	  inclusion.  It is **nonempty** and **directed** (`instNonemptyFinSubext`,
    25	  `directed_finSubext`), so `(FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ` is `IsCofiltered` — the shape the residual's
    26	  `[IsCofiltered J]` binder consumes.
    27	* `iSup_finSubext_eq_top` — `⨆ k'', k'' = ⊤`, i.e. **`K = colim k''`** at the lattice level.
    28	* `coe_iSup_finSubext` — the colimit-is-**union** identity `↑(⨆ k'', k'') = ⋃ k'', ↑k''`
    29	  (`IntermediateField.coe_iSup_of_directed`): every element of `K` already lives at a finite
    30	  stage.  This is the honest content of "`K_s = colim k''`": the test-scheme limit
    31	  `S_{K_s} = lim S_{k''}` is `Spec` of this filtered colimit of fields.
    32	* `isSeparable_finSubext` — every stage `k''/k` is **separable** (`Algebra.IsSeparable`,
    33	  inherited from `K/k` by `Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable`); with
    34	  `IntermediateField.isSeparable_iSup` the colimit is separable, so this is genuinely the
    35	  system of *finite separable* subextensions of `K_s/k`.
    36	
    37	All native `k`-algebra / scalar-tower instances come from the `IntermediateField` API
    38	(`Algebra k k''`, `IsScalarTower k k'' K`), per the I-0255 tower-diamond wall — no composite
    39	`RingHom.toAlgebra` `letI`s are built here.
    40	
    41	## The β1 residual (pinned — `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit`, in `PicRepColimitCompat`)
    42	
    43	The β1 reduction is LANDED (`PicRepColimitCompat.lean`, c9df8d479): the base-field-change
    44	functoriality of `pic0` is the landed natural iso `pic0ThetaType`, collapsing the varying-field
    45	colimit onto the single fixed functor `pic0TypeFunctor C` over `k`, whose base-field-colimit
    46	compatibility is the named `Prop`
    47	
    48	```
    49	Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C :=
    50	  ∀ ⦃J⦄ [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J] (S : J ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k))),
    51	    (∀ f, IsAffineHom (S.map f).left) → (∀ i, CompactSpace (S.obj i).left) →
    52	    (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (S.obj i).left) → ∀ [HasLimit S],
    53	      PreservesColimit S.op (pic0TypeFunctor C)
    54	```
    55	
    56	`instConsumesFiniteBaseColimit` below records that this `Prop` **applies to** the δ system:
    57	`(FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ` is `IsCofiltered`, so any cofiltered diagram `S` of test schemes indexed by
    58	it (in particular the `Spec`-of-tests limit `S_{K_s} = lim_{k''} S_{k''}`) is a legal input.
    59	
    60	**The residual proper is NOT discharged here** — it is genuinely M–L (I-0263): it says
    61	`pic0TypeFunctor C` is *locally of finite presentation as a functor*, which on affine tests
    62	`overSpec k A` is exactly that the affine relative-Picard construction `PicEtAff C A` commutes
    63	with filtered colimits of the test algebra `A`, riding finite presentation of the proper smooth
    64	curve `C/k`.  The precise remaining goal state and its named mathlib avatars
    65	(`CommRingCat.preservesColimit_coyoneda_of_finitePresentation`,
    66	`Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation`, …) are pinned in the
    67	`PicRepColimitCompat` module docstring and landing note I-0263; this file lands the δ substrate
    68	they act on and leaves the analytic core `sorry`-free-pinned (no `sorry` in this file).
    69	-/

    79	/-! ## DG-G0.δ — the base-field directed system `K_s = colim k''` -/
    80	
    81	section FieldSystem
    82	
    83	variable (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    84	
    85	/-- **The DG-G0.δ index** — the finite subextensions `k''` of a separable algebraic extension
    86	`K/k`, ordered by inclusion.  Its directed supremum is `K` (`iSup_finSubext_eq_top`); its
    87	opposite is the `IsCofiltered` shape the β1 residual `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit`
    88	quantifies over.  For `K = K_s` a separable closure these are exactly the *finite separable*
    89	subextensions of `K_s/k`. -/
    90	abbrev FinSubext : Type u := {L : IntermediateField k K // FiniteDimensional k L}
    91	
    92	variable {k K}
    93	
    94	/-- Each stage carries its finite-dimensionality as an instance. -/
    95	instance (L : FinSubext k K) : FiniteDimensional k L.1 := L.2
    96	
    97	variable (k K) in
    98	/-- The δ index is nonempty (`k` itself, as `⊥`, is a finite subextension). -/
    99	instance instNonemptyFinSubext [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] : Nonempty (FinSubext k K) :=
   100	  ⟨⟨k⟮(0 : K)⟯, adjoin.finiteDimensional (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _)⟩⟩
   101	
   102	/-- **DG-G0.δ, directedness.**  The finite subextensions of `K/k` are directed under inclusion:
   103	the join `k'' ⊔ k'''` of two finite subextensions is again finite.  Hence `(FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ` is
   104	`IsCofiltered` — the shape the residual consumes. -/
   105	theorem directed_finSubext :
   106	    Directed (· ≤ ·) (fun L : FinSubext k K => (L.1 : IntermediateField k K)) := by
   107	  intro L₁ L₂
   108	  haveI := L₁.2
   109	  haveI := L₂.2
   110	  exact ⟨⟨L₁.1 ⊔ L₂.1, IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_sup _ _⟩, le_sup_left, le_sup_right⟩
   111	
   112	/-- **DG-G0.δ, `IsDirected`.**  The δ index is a directed order (from `directed_finSubext`), so it
   113	is `IsFiltered` and its opposite `(FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ` is `IsCofiltered` — automatically, via
   114	`isFiltered_of_directed_le_nonempty` and `isCofiltered_op_of_isFiltered`. -/
   115	instance instIsDirectedFinSubext [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] :
   116	    IsDirected (FinSubext k K) (· ≤ ·) :=
   117	  ⟨fun L₁ L₂ => directed_finSubext L₁ L₂⟩
   118	
   119	/-- **DG-G0.δ, the cofiltered shape the residual consumes.**  `(FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ` is
   120	`IsCofiltered` — exactly the `[IsCofiltered J]` shape of `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit`'s
   121	diagram binder.  A cofiltered diagram of test schemes `S : (FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Over (Spec k)`
   122	indexed by it — in particular the `Spec`-of-tests limit `S_{K_s} = lim_{k''} S_{k''}` (with
   123	affine transition maps `Spec k''' → Spec k''` and one-point, hence compact and quasi-separated,
   124	stages) — is therefore a legal input to the β1 residual. -/
   125	instance instIsCofilteredFinSubextOp [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] :
   126	    IsCofiltered (FinSubext k K)ᵒᵖ :=
   127	  inferInstance
   128	
   129	/-- **DG-G0.δ, the colimit at the lattice level: `K = colim k''`.**  For an algebraic extension
   130	`K/k` the supremum of the finite subextensions is all of `K`: every `x : K` is algebraic, hence
   131	lies in the finite subextension `k⟮x⟯`. -/
   132	theorem iSup_finSubext_eq_top [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] :
   133	    ⨆ L : FinSubext k K, (L.1 : IntermediateField k K) = ⊤ :=
   134	  le_top.antisymm fun x _ =>
   135	    le_iSup (fun L : FinSubext k K => (L.1 : IntermediateField k K))
   136	      ⟨k⟮x⟯, adjoin.finiteDimensional (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)⟩ <|
   137	      mem_adjoin_simple_self k x
   138	
   139	/-- **DG-G0.δ, colimit-is-union.**  The directed supremum of the finite subextensions is their
   140	set-theoretic **union** (`IntermediateField.coe_iSup_of_directed`): the honest "`K_s = colim k''`"
   141	statement.  Combined with `iSup_finSubext_eq_top`, every element of `K` already lives at a finite
   142	stage `k''`. -/
   143	theorem coe_iSup_finSubext [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] :
   144	    (↑(⨆ L : FinSubext k K, (L.1 : IntermediateField k K)) : Set K)
   145	      = ⋃ L : FinSubext k K, (L.1 : Set K) :=
   146	  IntermediateField.coe_iSup_of_directed directed_finSubext
   147	
   148	/-- **DG-G0.δ, separability of each stage.**  Every finite subextension `k''/k` of a separable
   149	extension `K/k` is itself separable (`Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable` on the native
   150	tower `k → k'' → K`).  With `IntermediateField.isSeparable_iSup` the colimit `⨆ k''` is separable,
   151	so the δ system is the directed system of *finite separable* subextensions. -/
   152	instance isSeparable_finSubext [Algebra.IsSeparable k K] (L : FinSubext k K) :
   153	    Algebra.IsSeparable k L.1 :=
   154	  Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable k L.1 K
   155

   156	/-! ## A general lemma: `MonObj.ofRepresentableBy` transports along presheaf-of-monoid isos -/

   164	/-- **`MonObj.ofRepresentableBy` is invariant under transport of the representing datum along a
   165	presheaf-of-monoids isomorphism** (the reusable half of B-6a): if `Φ : F ≅ F'` is an isomorphism of
   166	presheaves of monoids whose forgetful action intertwines the universal `homEquiv`s of two
   167	representability data `α`, `α'` for a common representing object `X`, then the two induced
   168	`MonObj X` structures coincide.  Proved elementwise through `homEquiv`'s injectivity and the
   169	component multiplicativity of `Φ.hom`, never diagram-chasing in `Mon _` (the R3 term-mode
   170	discipline). -/
   171	theorem monObj_ofRepresentableBy_eq_of_iso {D : Type u₁} [Category.{w} D]
   172	    [CartesianMonoidalCategory D] {F F' : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ MonCat.{w}} (Φ : F ≅ F') {X : D}
   173	    (α : (F ⋙ CategoryTheory.forget _).RepresentableBy X)
   174	    (α' : (F' ⋙ CategoryTheory.forget _).RepresentableBy X)
   175	    (h : ∀ {T : D} (g : T ⟶ X), α'.homEquiv g = Φ.hom.app (op T) (α.homEquiv g)) :
   176	    MonObj.ofRepresentableBy X F α = MonObj.ofRepresentableBy X F' α' := by
   177	  refine MonObj.ext _ _ ?_
   178	  simp only [MonObj.ofRepresentableBy_mul, Functor.RepresentableBy.homEquiv']
   179	  apply α'.homEquiv.injective
   180	  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, h, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, map_mul, ← h, ← h]
   181	
   182	end OfRepTransport

    11	
    12	The glue package extends the finite-presentation models from `M` to a final finite
    13	subextension `N`.  Extending once more to the separably closed field cancels the tower
    14	`M -> N -> k`.  The resulting component equivalences recover the exact Picard atlas
    15	rings and intertwine every restriction and transition map.

    33	/-- A finite-presentation model ring after extension to the final finite subextension. -/

    35	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    36	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    37	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C -> Nat)

    39	    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    40	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext M.1 k)
    41	    (j : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) : Type u :=
    42	  N.1 ⊗[M.1] Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M j
    43

    47	/-- Scalar extension of a final finite-stage model ring recovers its exact atlas ring. -/
    48	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
    49	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    50	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    51	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C -> Nat)
    52	    (relation : forall j, Fin (m j) -> MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    53	    (e : forall j,
    54	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
    55	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
    56	    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    57	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext M.1 k)
    58	    (j : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) :
    59	    k ⊗[N.1] Pic0FiniteStageFinalModelRing C L n m relation M N j ≃ₐ[k]

    61	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange M.1 N.1 k k
    62	    (Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M j)).trans
    63	      (pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M j)

    68	/-- The final component comparisons intertwine every scalar-extended finite-stage map

    70	theorem pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv_naturality
    71	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    72	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    73	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C -> Nat)
    74	    (relation : forall j, Fin (m j) -> MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    75	    (e : forall j,
    76	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
    77	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
    78	    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    79	    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic M.1 k]
    80	    (mapM : forall q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
    81	      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
    82	          (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
    83	        Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
    84	          (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    85	    (hmapM : forall q,
    86	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
    87	          (AlgHom.id L.1
    88	            (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
    89	              (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    90	              (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    91	              (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))))).comp
    92	          ((mapM q).restrictScalars L.1) =
    93	        ((pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e q).restrictScalars
    94	          L.1).comp
    95	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
    96	            (AlgHom.id L.1
    97	              (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
    98	                (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
    99	                (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))

   102	    (q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C) :
   103	    (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M N
   104	        (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)).toAlgHom.comp
   105	        (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   106	          (R := N.1) (K := k)
   107	          (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   108	            (R := M.1) (K := N.1) (mapM q))) =
   109	      (pic0FiniteStageMap C q).comp
   110	        (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M N
   111	          (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)).toAlgHom := by
   112	  have hval : N.1.val = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom M.1 N.1 k := by
   113	    ext x
   114	    rfl
   115	  have htower :=
   116	    scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tower_finSubext (K := k) N (mapM q)
   117	  rw [hval] at htower
   118	  have hcancel := AlgebraicJacobian.cancelBaseChange_naturality
   119	    (F := M.1) (L := N.1) (K := k)
   120	    (phiL := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   121	      (R := M.1) (K := N.1) (mapM q))
   122	    (phiK := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   123	      (R := M.1) (K := k) (mapM q))
   124	    htower
   125	  have hmodel := pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv_naturality
   126	    C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM q
   127	  let eTarget := (pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M
   128	    (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)).toAlgHom
   129	  let eSource := (pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M
   130	    (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)).toAlgHom
   131	  let cTarget := (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange M.1 N.1 k k
   132	    (Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
   133	      (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))).toAlgHom
   134	  let cSource := (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange M.1 N.1 k k
   135	    (Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
   136	      (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))).toAlgHom
   137	  let fN := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   138	    (R := N.1) (K := k)
   139	    (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   140	      (R := M.1) (K := N.1) (mapM q))
   141	  let fK := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   142	    (R := M.1) (K := k) (mapM q)
   143	  let g := pic0FiniteStageMap C q
   144	  change cTarget.comp fN = fK.comp cSource at hcancel
   145	  change eTarget.comp fK = g.comp eSource at hmodel
   146	  change (eTarget.comp cTarget).comp fN = g.comp (eSource.comp cSource)

   148	    _ = eTarget.comp (cTarget.comp fN) := AlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _

   152	    _ = (g.comp eSource).comp cSource :=
   153	      congrArg (fun f => f.comp cSource) hmodel

    12	
    13	A `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `K ⊗[F] B` descends to a datum over
    14	`M ⊗[F] B` for a finite intermediate field `M/F`.  The datum is first descended to a
    15	finitely generated coefficient subalgebra, then that subalgebra is factored through one
    16	finite tensor stage.  The tower law for datum base change transports the certificate strictly.
    17	-/

    31	/-- Spread a pinned cocycle datum over `K ⊗[F] B` to one finite tensor stage over `F`. -/
    32	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_finSubext_tensorStage
    33	    {F K B : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K]
    34	    [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    35	    {C : Over (Spec (.of F))} {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 F} [IsAffineHom pi]
    36	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (K ⊗[F] B) pi) :
    37	    ∃ M : DatG0.FinSubext F K,
    38	      letI : Algebra F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
    39	      let ι : M.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] B :=
    40	        Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
    41	      letI : Algebra (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) := ι.toAlgebra
    42	      letI : IsScalarTower F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    43	        @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B)
    44	          inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    45	          (fun x => (ι.commutes x).symm)
    46	      ∃ D_M : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (M.1 ⊗[F] B) pi,
    47	        D_M.baseChange (K ⊗[F] B) = D := by
    48	  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀, D₀, hD₀⟩ := D.exists_fg_subalgebra_baseChange_eq
    49	  obtain ⟨M, f, hfactor⟩ :=
    50	    DatG0.exists_finSubext_fg_subalgebra_tensorProduct_factor A₀ hA₀
    51	  letI : Algebra F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
    52	  let ι : M.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] B :=
    53	    Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
    54	  letI : Algebra A₀ (M.1 ⊗[F] B) :=
    55	    f.toRingHom.toAlgebra' (by
    56	      intro c x
    57	      exact mul_comm (f.toRingHom c) x)
    58	  letI : IsScalarTower F A₀ (M.1 ⊗[F] B) :=
    59	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (f.commutes x).symm
    60	  letI : Algebra (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    61	    ι.toRingHom.toAlgebra' (by
    62	      intro c x
    63	      exact mul_comm (ι.toRingHom c) x)
    64	  letI : IsScalarTower F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    65	    @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B)
    66	      inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    67	      (fun x => (ι.commutes x).symm)
    68	  letI : IsScalarTower A₀ (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    69	    @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq A₀ (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B)

    71	      (fun a => by
    72	        change a.1 = ι (f a)

    76	  exact ⟨D₀.baseChange (M.1 ⊗[F] B),
    77	    (D₀.baseChange_baseChange C (A₀ : Type u) (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B)).trans hD₀⟩

     9	/-!
    10	# A finitely presented Picard representative preserves filtered base colimits
    11	
    12	Representability turns the fixed-base Picard-zero functor into the functor of morphisms to its
    13	representing scheme.  If that scheme is locally of finite presentation, the scheme-theoretic
    14	finite-stage factorization and equality theorems show that this functor preserves the filtered
    15	colimits occurring in `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit`.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	/-- A locally finitely presented scheme representing `pic0TypeFunctor C` discharges the
    27	fixed-base filtered-colimit residual `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C`. -/
    28	theorem pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit_of_representableBy
    29	    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    32	    (J : Over (Spec (.of k))) (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J)
    33	    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation J.hom] :
    34	    Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C := by
    35	  intro I _ _ S h_aff hcompact hqs _
    36	  letI : IsConnected I := IsCofiltered.isConnected I
    37	  let D := S ⋙ Over.forget (Spec (.of k))
    38	  let t : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj (Spec (.of k)) :=
    39	    { app := fun i => (S.obj i).hom
    40	      naturality := fun {i j} f => by
    41	        change (S.map f).left ≫ (S.obj j).hom = (S.obj i).hom ≫ 𝟙 _
    42	        rw [Category.comp_id]
    43	        exact Over.w (S.map f) }
    44	  let c : Cone D := (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).mapCone (limit.cone S)
    45	  have hc : IsLimit c :=
    46	    isLimitOfPreserves (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))) (limit.isLimit S)
    47	  letI {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j) : IsAffineHom (D.map f) := h_aff f
    48	  letI (i : I) : CompactSpace (D.obj i) := hcompact i
    49	  letI (i : I) : QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i) := hqs i
    50	  refine preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone
    51	    (K := S.op) (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) (limit.isLimit S).op ?_
    52	  refine Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' (S.op ⋙ pic0TypeFunctor C)
    53	    ((pic0TypeFunctor C).mapCocone (limit.cone S).op) ?_ ?_
    54	  · intro x
    55	    let a : limit S ⟶ J := rep.homEquiv.symm x
    56	    have ha : c.π ≫ t = (Functor.const I).map (a.left ≫ J.hom) := by
    57	      ext i
    58	      change (limit.π S i).left ≫ (S.obj i).hom = a.left ≫ J.hom
    59	      rw [Over.w (limit.π S i), Over.w a]
    60	    obtain ⟨i, g, hg, hgbase⟩ :=
    61	      Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation
    62	        D t J.hom c hc a.left ha
    63	    let g' : S.obj i ⟶ J := Over.homMk g hgbase
    64	    refine ⟨op i, rep.homEquiv g', ?_⟩
    65	    change x = (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (limit.π S i).op (rep.homEquiv g')
    66	    rw [← rep.homEquiv_comp]
    67	    rw [show x = rep.homEquiv a from (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply x).symm]
    68	    apply congrArg rep.homEquiv
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact hg.symm
    71	  · intro ii x y hxy
    72	    let i := unop ii
    73	    let a : S.obj i ⟶ J := rep.homEquiv.symm x
    74	    let b : S.obj i ⟶ J := rep.homEquiv.symm y
    75	    have ha : t.app i = a.left ≫ J.hom := (Over.w a).symm
    76	    have hb : t.app i = b.left ≫ J.hom := (Over.w b).symm
    77	    have habOver : limit.π S i ≫ a = limit.π S i ≫ b := by
    78	      apply rep.homEquiv.injective
    79	      rw [rep.homEquiv_comp, rep.homEquiv_comp,
    80	        rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply, rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    81	      exact hxy
    82	    have hab : c.π.app i ≫ a.left = c.π.app i ≫ b.left :=
    83	      congrArg Over.Hom.left habOver
    84	    obtain ⟨j, hji, heq⟩ :=
    85	      Scheme.exists_hom_comp_eq_comp_of_locallyOfFiniteType
    86	        D t J.hom c hc a.left b.left ha hb hab
    87	    refine ⟨op j, hji.op, ?_⟩
    88	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (S.map hji).op x =
    89	      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (S.map hji).op y
    90	    rw [show x = rep.homEquiv a from (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply x).symm,
    91	      show y = rep.homEquiv b from (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply y).symm,
    92	      ← rep.homEquiv_comp, ← rep.homEquiv_comp]
    93	    apply congrArg rep.homEquiv
    94	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    95	    exact heq

    22	over a field, proper over that field.
    23	
    24	## Main definitions
    25	
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.genus` — genus of a proper, smooth curve.

    31	
    32	## Main theorems
    33	
    34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus` — the Jacobian is smooth of relative
    35	  dimension `g = genus C`.
    36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp` — the universal property: the Jacobian is
